messages:
alex: Heads up — CI on main is red: gpu-e2e/runtime-tests failing `tests/runtime/test_kv_cache.py::test_replay` with a timeout in 'replay kv'. Looks like it started after yesterday's merges.

maria: I saw that. Fails on ubuntu-gpu runners with `TimeoutError: RPC wait exceeded`. I reproduced a flaky timeout locally against the prod docker image.

sam: I can take a bisect. Do we have a reliable local repro? Bisecting blind on CI is slow.

alex: Buildkite shows last green was commit 9a1f3c2 (yesterday morning). We do have a local repro if you run the test with --runslow and the GPU image. Link to failing CI: <https://ci.redwood/example/1258>.

sam: OK starting git bisect against origin/main. Steps I'm using:

```
# start bisect
git fetch origin
git bisect start
git bisect bad origin/main
git bisect good 9a1f3c2
# run the failing test quickly
pytest tests/runtime/test_kv_cache.py::test_replay -q --maxfail=1
```

maria: FYI PR #4327 merged yesterday changed shard placement and bumped some RPC timeout behavior. That PR touched rpc_client.py and the shard allocator. Might be related.

sam: bisect landed on commit bf47e12 (merge of PR #4327). Running the test now on that commit.

ci-bot: triggered rerun of gpu-e2e/runtime-tests #1258 (requested by @sam)

sam: Reproduced locally on bf47e12 — test times out. Adding quick logs shows requests stuck in `rpc_client.py:send()` waiting on a response for ~12s before raising.

alex: If that's the culprit we should revert the merge and ship a fix. Maria, can you propose a short mitigation (increase timeout or fallback)?

maria: I'll open a hotfix PR to increase the RPC timeout to 15s and add a guard to avoid blocking the shard move path. Will run CI on the hotfix branch and report back.

dave: +1 on adding metrics for RPC latency in the same change so we can alert before it becomes a test failure.

sam: marking bisect result: culprit commit `bf47e12` (merge PR #4327). I captured the bisect log and a small repro script.

alex: Great. @ops-jenkins please kick a full matrix run after the hotfix merges and revert if anything else breaks.

ops-jenkins: acknowledged — will watch the hotfix PR and queue the full matrix once merged.
